primary.limitation_of_liability_explanation: The pre-existing back condition substantially exacerbated the injury from the accident.
primary.nature_of_injury: Severe back injury with permanent partial disability due to prior condition.
primary.disability_documentation: Medical reports from Dr. Emily White dated 04/01/2023 and 06/15/2023.
primary.pre_existing_disability_documentation: Employer records from Olson-Mccoy showing prior back issues.
primary.injury_cause_explanation: Combined effect of accident and pre-existing condition resulted in greater disability.
primary.pending_issues: Dispute over extent of disability compensation with carrier.
primary.earning_capacity_documentation: Earnings records from Olson-Mccoy for the past 12 months.
